picks.headline: These are the first five Googlebook laptops
picks.excerpt: Would you buy one of the new Googlebooks at these prices?
picks.rationale: A whole new laptop category ships at once from Acer, Asus, HP, Lenovo and Dell — the first concrete spec-and-price picture of Google's ChromeOS/Android merge.

picks.headline: Apple's M6 Mac Mini Is Perfect for the AI Curious
picks.excerpt: Apple has refreshed the Mac Mini with a brand new chip, the M6. And this time, it's more focused on AI than ever.
picks.rationale: The cheapest way into Apple silicon is now tuned for running models locally — a real buying decision for anyone weighing a local-AI desktop.

picks.headline: Apple Smart Home Display Coming as Soon as Next Month
picks.excerpt: Apple could unveil its long-rumored smart home display as soon as October, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. In the latest edition of his "Power On" newsletter, Gurman narrows Apple's launch window after he said in August that the smart home display remained on track to arrive before the end of
picks.rationale: Gurman narrows Apple's first new product category in years to October, putting an Apple-shaped rival next to Google's and Amazon's smart displays.

picks.headline: Meta Reportedly Unveiling Next-gen MR Headset at Connect, Hologram-like Call Experience
picks.excerpt: Meta isn't only rumored to unveil its next-gen mixed reality headset next week, but also a photorealistic "hologram-like" call function using its latest avatars. Images of Meta's upcoming Project Phoenix headset have already leaked ahead of Meta's Connect developer conference next week, which strong
picks.rationale: Leaked Project Phoenix images plus a photoreal codec-avatar calling feature set the agenda for Meta Connect on Sept 23-24.

picks.headline: AI glasses shipments surged 263% in H1 2026 as Apple prepares to enter the market
picks.excerpt: Global AI glasses shipments surged 263% during the first half of 2026, with Meta comfortably leading the display-less segment amid growing privacy concerns.
picks.rationale: Hard numbers behind the smart-glasses boom: display-less models take 96% of shipments and Meta leads, just as Apple readies its own entry.
